About

We're hiring a Product Manager to own and ship core parts of Stream.

You'll join a small product team and work directly with our Product Lead to decide what Stream does next: which problems to take on, for which users, and where the product can go further

This isn't a traditional PM role. Stream spans an app, hardware, and multimodal interface, and most of the work is 0 to 1. You'll stay close to customers, catch problems early, and bring your own point of view on voice, AI, and human-computer interaction. Some weeks you'll write PRDs. Responsibilities

 - Own one or more product areas end to end: write PRDs, make UX and scope calls, and handle the details through release

 - Make fast, sound calls as new information comes in

 - Align hardware, software, and design on your plans, and share progress and recommendations with the Product team

 - Combine user feedback, research, market signals, and data to find opportunities and set priorities

 - Define success metrics and measure whether shipped work improved the experience

 - Run user interviews, studies, and beta tests

 - Help shape how Stream uses voice, AI, and personal context

Qualifications

 - 5+ years in product at an AI, consumer tech, or hardware company

 - You've taken products from problem definition through launch

 - You write clear specs, make good trade-offs, and use simple frameworks to guide decisions

 - You use AI tools every day and have opinions on how they should work

 - You make UX decisions with design, and you sketch wireframes or prototypes to show your ideas

 - You turn user conversations into product decisions

JOB DESCRIPTION

We’re seeking an Associate Sourcing Specialist to help bring innovative products to life by leading supplier purchasing initiatives and building high-performing supplier partnerships. Working across cross-functional teams, you’ll help ensure critical materials and components are available to support development, production, and long-term success in a highly regulated and capacity-constrained environment.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the sourcing and procurement of munitions commodities across defense suppliers.

 - Identify, qualify, onboard, and manage suppliers capable of meeting cost, quality, delivery, and technical requirements for prototype, development, and production builds.

 - Demonstrated expertise in ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and U.S. government contracting requirements, including experience working with export-controlled materials and compliance frameworks.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple suppliers and priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
